Canada Imposes Countertariffs on US Goods

Canada has imposed countertariffs on a range of United States goods, including steel, aluminum, and consumer products. The move comes in response to similar tariffs previously enacted by the U.S. administration. Canadian officials stated the tariffs are a necessary measure to protect domestic industries and respond to unfair trade practices. The tariffs are expected to impact Canadian consumers and businesses, potentially increasing prices for certain goods. The specific value of the goods affected by the tariffs has not been fully detailed, but it is expected to be substantial.
